caption: CBOW's hidden vector h = [1, 0] scores each output vector; exponentiating and dividing by Z = 4.086 gives the softmax, and the true centre word cat gets 0.665.

spec.title: CBOW: h = [1, 0]
spec.aria: A vertical chain starts from h = [1, 0], computes scores cat 1, dog 0, fish −1, exponentiates to 2.718, 1.000, 0.368, divides by Z = 4.086, and gives probabilities cat 0.665, dog 0.245, fish 0.090.
